title: Israeli Strikes Kill 19 Across South Lebanon Including 3 Children and 4 Women
detail: Israeli airstrikes on Tuesday, May 19 killed at least 19 people across southern Lebanon, including 3 children and 4 women, in one of the deadliest single-day tolls of the week. A single strike on Deir Qanoun al-Nahr in the coastal Tyre (Sur) province killed 10 people — including 3 children and 3 women — in the worst incident of the day. A separate strike on Nabatieh city killed 4 people and wounded 10. A third strike on the nearby village of Kfar Sir killed 5 more. Lebanon's Health Ministry described the Deir Qanoun al-Nahr strike as among the deadliest single strikes of the week. The IDF stated it had targeted more than 25 Hezbollah infrastructure sites in south Lebanon in the 24-hour period, asserting that all strikes targeted military infrastructure. The attacks occurred just days after the announcement of a 45-day ceasefire extension, drawing renewed international calls for accountability.

title: IDF Captain Maoz Recanati, 24, Killed by Hezbollah Drone in South Lebanon
detail: IDF Captain Maoz Israel Recanati, 24, an infantry platoon commander, was killed by a Hezbollah drone strike in south Lebanon on May 19. His death was among the most senior IDF officer fatalities in the 2026 renewed conflict. The killing illustrated the lethality of Hezbollah's drone campaign, which now combined fiber-optic FPV drones (resistant to electronic jamming) with conventional radio-controlled explosive UAVs. IDF commanders and officers have become priority targets for Hezbollah's increasingly precise drone programme. The loss of an infantry platoon commander operating in south Lebanon underscored the ongoing costs of maintaining ground positions in Lebanese territory months after the April 16 ceasefire was declared.
